justification: A depicts two large, naturalistically modelled human figures in profile facing one another, elaborately coiffed and bearded, holding and exchanging objects, filling the field as a single coherent scene; B depicts a scatter of tiny, highly schematic linear signs \u2014 small bird-like creatures, footprint marks and an abstract lattice/comb figure \u2014 distributed loosely across an open field with no interaction between them. Beyond the trivial fact that both include profile-oriented figures, there is no shared motif, relationship, arrangement or drawing convention: one is a detailed figural encounter, the other a dispersed set of abstract stick-signs.
